text: dsh-plugin-toggle 是一款 DSH Web 插件管理扩展：它在设置页列出已加载插件的名称、说明和状态，并提供启用或停用按钮。切换会更新加载器状态并写入 profile 配置，无需重启 DSH。它还会补丁官方插件清单界面，加入切换按钮与插件说明，并按 preset-switch 状态隐藏会话标题中的预设菜单。适合通过网页管理 DSH 插件的用户。需要 DSH Web UI 与插件加载器，不需要额外 API 密钥。

dsh-plugin-toggle manages DSH plugins in the Web UI. It lists plugins and status, with controls to enable or disable them. Changes persist in the profile without restarting DSH. It patches the inventory UI and hides the preset menu when preset-switch is off. Requires DSH Web UI and plugin loader.

How can I manage loaded plugins without restarting DSH?
插件热插拔开关的功能「查看插件列表」：设置页读取已加载插件的名称、描述、状态和保护标记，并定时刷新列表。
插件热插拔开关的功能「切换插件状态」：在设置页点击启用或停用按钮后，请求服务端更新插件加载状态，并刷新显示。
dsh-plugin-toggle 的功能「保存切换状态」：切换插件时更新加载器，并将禁用状态保存到 profile 的补丁配置。
The “Protect core plugins” feature marks protected entries and refuses toggle requests for protected plugins.
dsh-plugin-toggle 使用前须知：启动时会重应用官方界面补丁，切换状态会写入 profile 配置文件。见 lib/index.js:516-521、581-587。
怎么查每个 DSH 插件的说明和是否正在运行？
I need a browser page to toggle plugins and keep the setting after restart.
@dsh-external/dsh-plugin-toggle README · dsh-plugin-toggle：Hot-plug enable/disable switches for installed DeepSeek Harness plugins, without restarting DSH.

@dsh-external/dsh-plugin-toggle README · Features：- List installed plugins with descriptions.
- Enable / disable plugins live.
- Protect core plugins (`CORE_DENYLIST`) from being disabled.
- Auto-applies patches to official plugin inventory UI on startup.
- The session-header preset dropdown now auto-hides when `dsh-preset-switch` is disabled (polling every 5s + on window focus, no manual refresh needed).
- Works in the DSH Web UI Plugin list.

@dsh-external/dsh-plugin-toggle README · Notes：- This plugin patches official client/host files at startup. It is idempotent and restores safe behavior when the target official files are in a broken state.
- No API keys or credentials are stored in this repository.
